description: This file contains controller functions for managing document stores, including creation, retrieval, updating, deletion, file chunk handling, vector store operations, and related utilities within a server-side application.

classes.name: DocumentStore
classes.description: Entity class representing a document store in the database.

methods.name: createDocumentStore
methods.description: Creates a new document store after validating request data and user context.

methods.name: getAllDocumentStores
methods.description: Retrieves all document stores for a given workspace with pagination.

methods.name: deleteLoaderFromDocumentStore
methods.description: Deletes a loader from a specified document store.

methods.name: getDocumentStoreById
methods.description: Fetches a specific document store by ID, including usage info.

methods.name: getDocumentStoreFileChunks
methods.description: Retrieves file chunks associated with a document store.

methods.name: deleteDocumentStoreFileChunk
methods.description: Deletes a specific file chunk from a document store.

methods.name: editDocumentStoreFileChunk
methods.description: Edits a file chunk's content and metadata.

methods.name: saveProcessingLoader
methods.description: Saves a processing loader state.

methods.name: processLoader
methods.description: Processes a loader middleware operation.

methods.name: updateDocumentStore
methods.description: Updates an existing document store with new data.

methods.name: deleteDocumentStore
methods.description: Deletes a document store by ID.

methods.name: previewFileChunks
methods.description: Previews file chunks with a preview flag.

methods.name: getDocumentLoaders
methods.description: Retrieves available document loaders.

methods.name: insertIntoVectorStore
methods.description: Inserts data into a vector store with optional strict save.

methods.name: queryVectorStore
methods.description: Queries the vector store with provided parameters.

methods.name: deleteVectorStoreFromStore
methods.description: Deletes a vector store from a document store.

methods.name: saveVectorStoreConfig
methods.description: Saves configuration for a vector store.

methods.name: updateVectorStoreConfigOnly
methods.description: Updates only the configuration of a vector store.

methods.name: getEmbeddingProviders
methods.description: Retrieves available embedding providers.

methods.name: getVectorStoreProviders
methods.description: Retrieves available vector store providers.

methods.name: getRecordManagerProviders
methods.description: Retrieves record manager providers.

methods.name: upsertDocStoreMiddleware
methods.description: Upserts a document store with files and metadata.

methods.name: refreshDocStoreMiddleware
methods.description: Refreshes a document store's data.

methods.name: generateDocStoreToolDesc
methods.description: Generates a tool description for a document store.
